name: Laws of the Republic of China (Taiwan): Constitution, Additional Articles and three codes (current text)
label: Taiwan
record_note: law.moj.gov.tw is used for current text only (its past-version pages and API are disallowed by robots.txt), so each law has one version, dated by the amendment or promulgation date its page states; that date is not a commencement day.

dates.commit: page date (修正日期 or 公布日期) of the current text

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: non-retroactivity of laws (法律不溯及既往原則)
default_reach.meaning: a law governs facts arising after it takes effect unless it says otherwise; in criminal law the law at the time of the act applies unless a later law is more favourable to the offender
default_reach.authority: 中央法規標準法 §13, §18; 中華民國刑法 §1, §2; 司法院釋字第525號、第574號 (protection of reliance)
